# SMS Forwarder Mac

Native macOS serial monitor for SMS forwarding devices; Chinese name: WIFI 转发宝串口助手. Open-source preview, MIT code license. macOS 13+. USB required for monitoring. Firmware-specific SMS parsing; not universal hardware support.

- [Overview](README.md): capabilities and compatibility boundaries.
- [English](docs/README.en.md): English product guide.
- [Channel tutorials](docs/tutorial/推送渠道教程.md): Bark verified on current device; other channels unverified.
- [Privacy](docs/隐私与来源.md): no raw logs, PDU or credentials in public materials.
- [Status](docs/项目状态与交接.md): implementation, build and release status.

Repository introductions: [日本語](docs/README.ja.md), [한국어](docs/README.ko.md), [Français](docs/README.fr.md), [Español](docs/README.es.md). The app UI and detailed tutorials remain Chinese.

- [Install](docs/下载安装.md): Chinese DMG and Gatekeeper guide; Build 7 is Developer ID signed and Apple-notarized.
- [First SMS](docs/快速上手.md): prerequisites, serial selection, phone-to-device SMS verification and troubleshooting.
- [License](LICENSE): MIT for project code; third-party assets retain their own rights.
